facts.value: The European Union will award scholarships to around 30 outstanding students in the first TELME cohort. These scholarships cover tuition fees, travel expenses, and living costs.
Study in several countries, explore diverse educational systems, join a vibrant international community of peers.
high-quality multilingual training in the field of language education
Université Rennes 2 (France), Åbo Akademi University (Finland), Adam Mickiewicz University (Poland), Universidad de Burgos (Spain), University of Limerick (Ireland)
Language teaching, curriculum and programme development, educational technology, intercultural communication, other language-related careers.
The programme combines strong theoretical foundations with practical experience, equipping you to succeed in a wide range of professional and academic contexts.
Scholarships are available for a limited time. Early applications are strongly encouraged.
